row.name: trade_listing_wants_shape_chk
row.value:
CASE "kind"
        WHEN 'exact' THEN coalesce("count", 0) > 0 AND num_nulls("slug", "artist", "member", "season", "class", "on_offline") = 0 AND num_nonnulls("artists", "members", "seasons", "classes", "on_offlines", "amount", "currency") = 0
        WHEN 'range' THEN coalesce("count", 0) > 0 AND num_nulls("artists", "members", "seasons", "classes", "on_offlines") = 0 AND num_nonnulls("slug", "artist", "member", "season", "class", "on_offline", "amount", "currency") = 0
        ELSE coalesce("amount", 0) > 0 AND "currency" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("count", "slug", "artist", "member", "season", "class", "on_offline", "artists", "members", "seasons", "classes", "on_offlines") = 0
      END

row.name: trade_messages_kind_chk
row.value: CASE "kind" WHEN 'text' THEN "event" IS NULL ELSE "event" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("body", "sender_id") = 0 END

row.name: trade_offer_items_objekt_chk
row.value: CASE "kind" WHEN 'objekt' THEN num_nulls("token_id", "slug", "artist", "member", "season", "class", "on_offline") = 0 AND num_nonnulls("amount", "currency", "method", "marked_paid_at", "confirmed_at") = 0 ELSE num_nonnulls("token_id", "slug", "artist", "member", "season", "class", "on_offline", "transferred_at", "tx_hash") = 0 AND coalesce("amount", 0) > 0 AND "currency" IS NOT NULL AND NOT "live" END

row.name: trade_offers_status_chk
row.value: CASE "kind" WHEN 'listing' THEN "status" IN ('open', 'claimed', 'filled', 'withdrawn', 'expired', 'broken', 'removed', 'abandoned') ELSE "status" IN ('pending', 'accepted', 'disputed', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'timed_out', 'declined', 'withdrawn', 'countered', 'expired', 'stale') END

row.name: trade_offers_trade_chk
row.value: "kind" = 'listing' OR ("to_address" IS NOT NULL AND "offers" IS NULL AND "note" IS NULL)

row.name: trade_offers_accepted_chk
row.value: "status" NOT IN ('accepted', 'disputed', 'completed', 'timed_out') OR ("deadline_at" IS NOT NULL AND "accepted_at" IS NOT NULL)

row.name: trade_offers_abandoned_chk
row.value: CASE WHEN "status" = 'timed_out' THEN coalesce(cardinality("abandoned_by"), 0) BETWEEN 1 AND 2 ELSE "abandoned_by" IS NULL END
